lessons.title: An fhoirm dhiúltach: Ní + séimhiú
lessons.en: Saying what does not happen: Ní + lenition
lessons.rule: To make a present-tense verb negative, put Ní in front of it and add h after the first letter: tagann becomes Ní thagann. Deir and verbs that begin with a vowel do not change (Ní deir, Ní itheann), and tá becomes Níl.
steps: Find the verb at the start of the sentence: Déanann.
Put Ní in front of it.
Add h after the first letter: Ní dhéanann.
Keep the rest of the sentence as it was: Ní dhéanann sí a dícheall sa rang Gaeilge.

example.prompt: Déanann sí a dícheall sa rang Gaeilge.
example.answer: Déanann sí a dícheall sa rang Gaeilge. -> Ní dhéanann sí a dícheall sa rang Gaeilge.

more.prompt: Tchí sé an bus ag teacht.
more.answer: Tchí sé an bus ag teacht. -> Ní fheiceann sé an bus ag teacht.

lessons.hint: Ní + h after the first letter; deir and vowels stay the same, tá becomes Níl.

lessons.title: An fhoirm cheisteach: An + urú
lessons.rule: To turn a sentence into a question, put An in front of the verb and eclipse it: tagann becomes An dtagann, beireann becomes An mbeireann. If the sentence has Ní, take away Ní and its h first; a vowel does not change (An itheann), and deir becomes An ndeir.
steps: Put An in front of it.
Eclipse the verb: t takes d, so An dtagann.
Keep the rest and add a question mark: An dtagann sé ar scoil ar an bhus?

example.prompt: Tagann sé ar scoil ar an bhus.
example.answer: Tagann sé ar scoil ar an bhus. -> An dtagann sé ar scoil ar an bhus?

more.prompt: Ní théann sé chuig an traenáil achan Satharn.
more.answer: Ní théann sé chuig an traenáil achan Satharn. -> An dtéann sé chuig an traenáil achan Satharn?

lessons.hint: An + eclipsis: b to mb, c to gc, d to nd, f to bhf, g to ng, p to bp, t to dt.

lessons.title: Ceist le tú agus sibh
lessons.en: Asking you: swap mé for tú and muid for sibh
lessons.rule: When the sentence is about me or us, the question is put to you: change the -im form to the verb with tú (Déanaim becomes An ndéanann tú?) and muid to sibh (Téann muid becomes An dtéann sibh?). Tá mé becomes An bhfuil tú?
steps: Find the verb and who does it: Itheann muid.
The question is put to the group, so change muid to sibh: Itheann sibh.
Put An in front; a vowel takes no eclipsis: An itheann sibh.
Keep the rest and add a question mark: An itheann sibh lón sa cheaintín?

example.answer: Itheann muid lón sa cheaintín. -> An itheann sibh lón sa cheaintín?

more.answer: Tagaim abhaile ar an bhus. -> An dtagann tú abhaile ar an bhus?
Tchím an bus ag teacht. -> An bhfeiceann tú an bus ag teacht?

lessons.hint: mé becomes tú, muid becomes sibh, then An + eclipsis.

lessons.title: Freagra gairid: dearfach agus diúltach
lessons.rule: Irish has no word for yes or no: for yes, repeat the verb with its subject (Cloisim), and for no, put Ní in front and add h (Ní chloisim). A question to tú is answered with the -im form, and the question An bhfeiceann tú? is answered Tchím or Ní fheicim.
steps: Take the verb from the question and remove the eclipsis: gcloiseann becomes cloiseann.
For yes, repeat it with the pronoun: Cloiseann sé.
For no, put Ní in front and add h: Ní chloiseann sé.
Write both answers after the question: Cloiseann sé. / Ní chloiseann sé.

example.prompt: An gcloiseann sé an fón ag bualadh achan mhaidin?
example.answer: An gcloiseann sé an fón ag bualadh achan mhaidin? Cloiseann sé. / Ní chloiseann sé.

more.answer: An bhfeiceann tú an bus? Tchím. / Ní fheicim.

more.prompt: An bhfuil sé go maith ag an pheil?
more.answer: An bhfuil sé go maith ag an pheil? Tá sé. / Níl sé.

lessons.hint: Repeat the verb for yes; Ní + h for no.

items.answer: An bhfaigheann tú teachtaireacht ar an fhón achan oíche? Faighim. / Ní fhaighim.

lessons.title: An saorbhriathar
lessons.en: The autonomous form: when nobody is named
lessons.rule: When you do not say who does the action, use the autonomous form, which ends in -tar, -tear or -ear and has no pronoun after it: tugann becomes Tugtar, cloiseann becomes Cloistear. Learn the forms from the tables: beirtear, cloistear, tagtar, itear, tugtar, déantar, feictear, deirtear, téitear, faightear.
steps: Find the verb in brackets: téigh.
Take its autonomous present form: téitear.
Put it first, with no pronoun after it: Téitear chuig an Ghaeltacht achan samhradh.

example.answer: Téitear chuig an Ghaeltacht achan samhradh.

more.answer: Itear lón sa cheaintín achan lá.

lessons.hint: No pronoun: use the -tar, -tear or -ear form.

items.answer: Faightear obair bhaile ar an táibléad achan oíche.

items.answer: Cloistear an nuacht ar an raidió achan mhaidin.

items.answer: Tugtar duais don fhoireann is fearr.

items.answer: Déantar iarracht airgead a bhailiú don scoil.
